description: Chapter summaries the reader shows under a chapter's title, keyed by chapter number, per language. Like section headings they are editorial aids, not translation: written from Open Word Bible's own wording, stating what the chapter is about and nothing more, so every language can say the same thing. They use no reader settings. Every summary is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1.en: At Gibeon Solomon asks God for wisdom and knowledge to lead the people, and God gives him wealth and honor as well.
1.sw: Huko Gibeoni Sulemani anamwomba Mungu hekima na maarifa ili kuwaongoza watu, na Mungu anampa pia utajiri na heshima.
1.am: በገባዖን ሰሎሞን ሕዝቡን ለመምራት ጥበብንና ዕውቀትን እግዚአብሔርን ይለምናል፤ እግዚአብሔርም ባለ ጠግነትንና ክብርን ደግሞ ይሰጠዋል።

2.en: Solomon prepares to build the temple and asks Huram king of Tyre for cedar and a skilled craftsman.
2.sw: Sulemani anajiandaa kujenga hekalu na kumwomba Huramu mfalme wa Tiro mierezi na fundi stadi.
2.am: ሰሎሞን ቤተ መቅደሱን ለመሥራት ይዘጋጃል፤ የጢሮስን ንጉሥ ሑራምንም ዝግባና ብልኅ የእጅ ባለ ሙያ ይለምነዋል።

3.en: Solomon builds the temple on Mount Moriah, with its most holy place, cherubim, curtain and two pillars.
3.sw: Sulemani anajenga hekalu juu ya mlima Moria, pamoja na Patakatifu pa Patakatifu, makerubi, pazia na nguzo mbili.
3.am: ሰሎሞን በሞሪያ ተራራ ላይ ቤተ መቅደሱን ከቅድስተ ቅዱሳኑ፣ ከኪሩቤል፣ ከመጋረጃውና ከሁለቱ ዓምዶች ጋር ይሠራል።

4.en: The bronze altar, the sea, the basins, the lampstands and the other furnishings are made.
4.sw: Madhabahu ya shaba, Bahari, mabirika, vinara vya taa na vyombo vingine vinatengenezwa.
4.am: የነሐሱ መሠዊያ፣ ኩሬው፣ የመታጠቢያ ሰኖቹ፣ መቅረዞቹና ሌሎቹ ዕቃዎች ይሠራሉ።

5.en: The ark is brought into the most holy place, the singers praise God, and the cloud of God's glory fills the temple.
5.sw: Sanduku linaletwa ndani ya Patakatifu pa Patakatifu, waimbaji wanamsifu Mungu, na wingu la utukufu wa Mungu linalijaza hekalu.
5.am: ታቦቱ ወደ ቅድስተ ቅዱሳኑ ይገባል፤ መዘምራኑ እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግናሉ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ደመና ቤተ መቅደሱን ይሞላዋል።

6.en: Solomon blesses the assembly and prays that God will hear the prayers made toward this house and forgive.
6.sw: Sulemani analibariki kusanyiko na kuomba kwamba Mungu asikie maombi yanayofanywa kuielekea nyumba hii na kusamehe.
6.am: ሰሎሞን ጉባኤውን ይባርካል፤ እግዚአብሔርም ወደዚህ ቤት የሚቀርበውን ጸሎት እንዲሰማና ይቅር እንዲል ይጸልያል።

7.en: Fire comes down from heaven, and God's glory fills the temple. God appears to Solomon and promises that if the people humble themselves and pray, God will hear and heal their land.
7.sw: Moto unashuka kutoka mbinguni, na utukufu wa Mungu unalijaza hekalu. Mungu anamtokea Sulemani na kuahidi kwamba watu wakijinyenyekeza na kuomba, Mungu atasikia na kuiponya nchi yao.
7.am: ከሰማይ እሳት ይወርዳል፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ቤተ መቅደሱን ይሞላዋል። እግዚአብሔር ለሰሎሞን ይገለጣል፤ ሕዝቡ ራሳቸውን አዋርደው ቢጸልዩ እንደሚሰማና ምድራቸውን እንደሚፈውስ ተስፋ ይሰጣል።

8.en: Solomon's building works, forced labor, worship and trade are described.
8.sw: Kazi za ujenzi za Sulemani, kazi ya kulazimishwa, ibada na biashara vinaelezwa.
8.am: የሰሎሞን የግንባታ ሥራዎች፣ የግዳጅ ሥራው፣ አምልኮውና ንግዱ ይገለጻሉ።

9.en: The queen of Sheba visits Solomon and praises his wisdom, and his wealth and fame are described. Solomon dies after reigning forty years.
9.sw: Malkia wa Sheba anamtembelea Sulemani na kuisifu hekima yake, na utajiri na umaarufu wake vinaelezwa. Sulemani anakufa baada ya kutawala miaka arobaini.
9.am: የሳባ ንግሥት ሰሎሞንን ትጎበኘዋለች፤ ጥበቡንም ታመሰግናለች፤ ሀብቱና ዝናውም ይገለጻሉ። ሰሎሞን አርባ ዓመት ከነገሠ በኋላ ይሞታል።

10.en: Rehoboam refuses to lighten the people's burdens, and Israel rebels and makes Jeroboam king.
10.sw: Rehoboamu anakataa kuyapunguza mizigo ya watu, na Israeli wanaasi na kumfanya Yeroboamu kuwa mfalme.
10.am: ሮብዓም የሕዝቡን ሸክም ለማቅለል እምቢ ይላል፤ እስራኤልም ዐምፀው ኢዮርብዓምን ያነግሣሉ።

11.en: Rehoboam fortifies Judah, and priests and Levites from the north come to him. His family is listed.
11.sw: Rehoboamu anaiimarisha Yuda kwa ngome, na makuhani na Walawi kutoka kaskazini wanakuja kwake. Jamaa yake inaorodheshwa.
11.am: ሮብዓም ይሁዳን ያጠናክራል፤ ከሰሜን የመጡ ካህናትና ሌዋውያንም ወደ እርሱ ይመጣሉ። ቤተ ሰቡም ይዘረዘራል።

12.en: Rehoboam abandons God's law, and Shishak of Egypt attacks Jerusalem. When the leaders humble themselves, God spares them from destruction.
12.sw: Rehoboamu anaiacha sheria ya Mungu, na Shishaki wa Misri anaishambulia Yerusalemu. Viongozi wanapojinyenyekeza, Mungu anawaepusha na maangamizi.
12.am: ሮብዓም የእግዚአብሔርን ሕግ ይተዋል፤ የግብፁ ሺሻቅም ኢየሩሳሌምን ይወጋል። መሪዎቹ ራሳቸውን ባዋረዱ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ከጥፋት ያድናቸዋል።

13.en: Abijah of Judah faces Jeroboam in battle and declares that God is with Judah, and Judah wins.
13.sw: Abiya wa Yuda anapambana na Yeroboamu vitani na kutangaza kwamba Mungu yuko pamoja na Yuda, na Yuda wanashinda.
13.am: የይሁዳው አብያ ኢዮርብዓምን በጦርነት ይገጥመዋል፤ እግዚአብሔር ከይሁዳ ጋር እንደ ሆነም ያውጃል፤ ይሁዳም ድል ያደርጋል።

14.en: Asa removes foreign altars and idols and seeks God, and defeats Zerah the Cushite.
14.sw: Asa anaziondoa madhabahu za kigeni na sanamu na kumtafuta Mungu, na kumshinda Zera Mkushi.
14.am: አሳ የባዕድ መሠዊያዎችንና ጣዖታትን ያስወግዳል፤ እግዚአብሔርን ይፈልጋል፤ ኩሻዊውን ዛራንም ድል ያደርጋል።

15.en: The prophet Azariah urges Asa to seek God, and Asa leads a covenant renewal and removes his grandmother as queen mother.
15.sw: Nabii Azaria anamsihi Asa amtafute Mungu, na Asa anaongoza watu kufanya upya agano na kumwondoa Maaka katika cheo cha mama wa mfalme.
15.am: ነቢዩ ዓዛርያስ አሳን እግዚአብሔርን እንዲፈልግ ያሳስበዋል፤ አሳም ሕዝቡን ቃል ኪዳኑን እንዲያድሱ ይመራል፤ መዓካንም ከንግሥት እናትነቷ ያወርዳታል።

16.en: Asa hires the king of Aram against Israel instead of relying on God, imprisons the seer who rebukes him, and in his illness seeks only physicians.
16.sw: Asa anamwajiri mfalme wa Aramu dhidi ya Israeli badala ya kumtegemea Mungu, anamtia gerezani mwonaji anayemkemea, na katika ugonjwa wake anawatafuta waganga tu.
16.am: አሳ በእግዚአብሔር ከመታመን ይልቅ የአራምን ንጉሥ በእስራኤል ላይ በገንዘብ ይቀጥራል፤ የሚገሥጸውን ባለ ራእይ በወህኒ ያኖራል፤ በሕመሙም ጊዜ ሐኪሞችን ብቻ ይፈልጋል።

17.en: Jehoshaphat strengthens Judah, follows God and sends officials and Levites to teach the law in every town.
17.sw: Yehoshafati anaiimarisha Yuda, anamfuata Mungu na kuwatuma maafisa na Walawi kufundisha sheria katika kila mji.
17.am: ኢዮሣፍጥ ይሁዳን ያጠናክራል፤ እግዚአብሔርን ይከተላል፤ በየከተማውም ሕጉን እንዲያስተምሩ ሹማምንትንና ሌዋውያንን ይልካል።

18.en: Jehoshaphat allies with Ahab against Aram, and the prophet Micaiah foretells defeat. Ahab dies in battle.
18.sw: Yehoshafati anashirikiana na Ahabu dhidi ya Aramu, na nabii Mikaya anatabiri kushindwa. Ahabu anakufa vitani.
18.am: ኢዮሣፍጥ አራምን ለመውጋት ከአክዓብ ጋር ይተባበራል፤ ነቢዩ ሚክያስም ሽንፈትን ይተነብያል። አክዓብ በጦርነት ይሞታል።

19.en: A seer rebukes Jehoshaphat for helping Ahab. Jehoshaphat appoints judges and tells them to judge fairly.
19.sw: Mwonaji anamkemea Yehoshafati kwa kumsaidia Ahabu. Yehoshafati anaweka waamuzi na kuwaambia waamue kwa haki.
19.am: አንድ ባለ ራእይ ኢዮሣፍጥን አክዓብን በመርዳቱ ይገሥጸዋል። ኢዮሣፍጥ ዳኞችን ይሾማል፤ በቅንነትም እንዲፈርዱ ይነግራቸዋል።

20.en: A great army comes against Judah, Jehoshaphat proclaims a fast and prays, and a Levite tells the people the battle is God's. As the singers praise, the enemies destroy one another.
20.sw: Jeshi kubwa linakuja dhidi ya Yuda, Yehoshafati anatangaza mfungo na kuomba, na Mlawi mmoja anawaambia watu kwamba vita ni vya Mungu. Waimbaji wanaposifu, adui wanaangamizana wenyewe kwa wenyewe.
20.am: ታላቅ ሠራዊት በይሁዳ ላይ ይመጣል፤ ኢዮሣፍጥ ጾም ያውጃል፤ ይጸልያልም፤ አንድ ሌዋዊም ጦርነቱ የእግዚአብሔር መሆኑን ለሕዝቡ ይነግራቸዋል። መዘምራኑ ሲያመሰግኑ ጠላቶቹ እርስ በርሳቸው ይጠፋፋሉ።

21.en: Jehoram kills his brothers, does evil and receives a letter of judgment from Elijah. Edom revolts, and Jehoram dies of a painful disease.
21.sw: Yehoramu anawaua ndugu zake, anatenda maovu na kupokea waraka wa hukumu kutoka kwa Eliya. Edomu wanaasi, na Yehoramu anakufa kwa ugonjwa wenye maumivu makali.
21.am: ኢዮራም ወንድሞቹን ይገድላል፤ ክፉ ያደርጋል፤ ከኤልያስም የፍርድ ደብዳቤ ይደርሰዋል። ኤዶም ያምፃል፤ ኢዮራምም በሚያሠቃይ በሽታ ይሞታል።

22.en: Ahaziah follows Ahab's ways and is killed by Jehu. Athaliah seizes the throne, but Joash is hidden in the temple.
22.sw: Ahazia anafuata njia za Ahabu na kuuawa na Yehu. Athalia anakinyakua kiti cha enzi, lakini Yoashi anafichwa hekaluni.
22.am: አካዝያስ የአክዓብን መንገድ ይከተላል፤ በኢዩም ይገደላል። ጎቶልያ ዙፋኑን ትይዛለች፤ ኢዮአስ ግን በቤተ መቅደስ ይሸሸጋል።

23.en: Jehoiada the priest crowns Joash, Athaliah is killed, and the people renew the covenant.
23.sw: Yehoyada kuhani anamvika Yoashi taji, Athalia anauawa, na watu wanafanya upya agano.
23.am: ካህኑ ዮዳሄ ኢዮአስን ያነግሠዋል፤ ጎቶልያ ትገደላለች፤ ሕዝቡም ቃል ኪዳኑን ያድሳሉ።

24.en: Joash repairs the temple, but after Jehoiada dies he turns to idols and has Zechariah the priest stoned. Aram defeats Judah, and Joash is murdered.
24.sw: Yoashi anarekebisha hekalu, lakini baada ya Yehoyada kufa anageukia sanamu na kuamuru Zekaria kuhani apigwe kwa mawe. Aramu wanaishinda Yuda, na Yoashi anauawa.
24.am: ኢዮአስ ቤተ መቅደሱን ያድሳል፤ ዮዳሄ ከሞተ በኋላ ግን ወደ ጣዖታት ዞሮ ካህኑ ዘካርያስ በድንጋይ እንዲወገር ያደርጋል። አራም ይሁዳን ድል ያደርጋል፤ ኢዮአስም ይገደላል።

25.en: Amaziah defeats Edom but brings back their gods. He challenges Israel, is defeated, and is later killed.
25.sw: Amazia anawashinda Edomu lakini analeta miungu yao. Anampa changamoto Israeli, anashindwa, na baadaye anauawa.
25.am: አሜስያስ ኤዶምን ድል ያደርጋል፤ አማልክታቸውን ግን ይዞ ይመለሳል። እስራኤልን ይገዳደራል፤ ድል ይሆናል፤ ኋላም ይገደላል።

26.en: Uzziah prospers while he seeks God, but in his pride he burns incense in the temple and is struck with skin disease.
26.sw: Uzia anafanikiwa wakati anapomtafuta Mungu, lakini kwa kiburi chake anafukiza uvumba hekaluni na kupigwa kwa ugonjwa mbaya wa ngozi.
26.am: ዖዝያን እግዚአብሔርን በፈለገ ጊዜ ይከናወንለታል፤ በትዕቢቱ ግን በቤተ መቅደስ ዕጣን ያጥናል፤ በከባድ የቆዳ በሽታም ይመታል።

27.en: Jotham grows strong because he walks steadily before God.
27.sw: Yothamu anapata nguvu kwa sababu anaziweka njia zake imara mbele za Mungu.
27.am: ኢዮአታም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት መንገዱን ስላጸና ይበረታል።

28.en: Ahaz worships other gods and is defeated by Aram and Israel. A prophet persuades Israel to free the captives from Judah, and Ahaz closes the temple.
28.sw: Ahazi anaabudu miungu mingine na kushindwa na Aramu na Israeli. Nabii mmoja anawashawishi Israeli wawaachilie mateka wa Yuda, na Ahazi analifunga hekalu.
28.am: አካዝ ሌሎች አማልክትን ያመልካል፤ በአራምና በእስራኤልም ድል ይሆናል። አንድ ነቢይ እስራኤል የይሁዳን ምርኮኞች እንዲለቁ ያግባባቸዋል፤ አካዝም ቤተ መቅደሱን ይዘጋል።

29.en: Hezekiah opens and cleanses the temple, and the priests and Levites restore its worship with sacrifices and songs.
29.sw: Hezekia analifungua na kulitakasa hekalu, na makuhani na Walawi wanairudisha ibada yake kwa dhabihu na nyimbo.
29.am: ሕዝቅያስ ቤተ መቅደሱን ይከፍታል፤ ያነጻዋልም፤ ካህናቱና ሌዋውያኑም አምልኮውን በመሥዋዕትና በመዝሙር ያድሳሉ።

30.en: Hezekiah invites all Israel and Judah to keep the Passover in Jerusalem, and there is great joy, the greatest since Solomon's day.
30.sw: Hezekia anawaalika Israeli wote na Yuda waadhimishe Pasaka huko Yerusalemu, na kuna furaha kuu, kubwa kuliko yote tangu siku za Sulemani.
30.am: ሕዝቅያስ እስራኤልንና ይሁዳን ሁሉ በኢየሩሳሌም ፋሲካን እንዲያከብሩ ይጋብዛቸዋል፤ ከሰሎሞን ዘመን ወዲህ ያልታየ ታላቅ ደስታም ይሆናል።

31.en: The people destroy idols throughout the land, and Hezekiah organizes the priests and Levites and their support.
31.sw: Watu wanaziharibu sanamu kote nchini, na Hezekia anawapanga makuhani na Walawi na riziki yao.
31.am: ሕዝቡ በምድሪቱ ሁሉ ጣዖታትን ያጠፋሉ፤ ሕዝቅያስም ካህናቱንና ሌዋውያኑን እንዲሁም ቀለባቸውን ያደራጃል።

32.en: Sennacherib of Assyria invades, and Hezekiah encourages the people to trust God. An angel destroys the Assyrian army, and Hezekiah's illness and pride are recorded.
32.sw: Senakeribu wa Ashuru anavamia, na Hezekia anawatia moyo watu wamtumaini Mungu. Malaika analiangamiza jeshi la Ashuru, na ugonjwa wa Hezekia na kiburi chake vinaandikwa.
32.am: የአሦሩ ሰናክሬም ይወርራል፤ ሕዝቅያስም ሕዝቡን በእግዚአብሔር እንዲታመኑ ያበረታታቸዋል። አንድ መልአክ የአሦርን ሠራዊት ያጠፋል፤ የሕዝቅያስ ሕመምና ትዕቢትም ይመዘገባሉ።

33.en: Manasseh does great evil, is taken captive to Babylon, humbles himself and is restored. Amon reigns briefly and is murdered.
33.sw: Manase anatenda maovu makubwa, anachukuliwa mateka hadi Babeli, anajinyenyekeza na kurudishwa. Amoni anatawala kwa muda mfupi na kuuawa.
33.am: ምናሴ ታላቅ ክፋት ያደርጋል፤ ተማርኮ ወደ ባቢሎን ይወሰዳል፤ ራሱን ያዋርዳል፤ ወደ መንግሥቱም ይመለሳል። አሞን ለጥቂት ጊዜ ይነግሣል፤ ይገደላልም።

34.en: Josiah seeks God, removes idols, and repairs the temple, where the book of the law is found. Huldah the prophet speaks of judgment, and Josiah renews the covenant.
34.sw: Yosia anamtafuta Mungu, anaziondoa sanamu na kurekebisha hekalu, ambapo kitabu cha Sheria kinapatikana. Nabii Hulda anazungumza juu ya hukumu, na Yosia anafanya upya agano.
34.am: ኢዮስያስ እግዚአብሔርን ይፈልጋል፤ ጣዖታትን ያስወግዳል፤ ቤተ መቅደሱንም ያድሳል፤ በዚያም የሕግ መጽሐፍ ይገኛል። ነቢይቱ ሕልዳና ስለ ፍርድ ትናገራለች፤ ኢዮስያስም ቃል ኪዳኑን ያድሳል።

35.en: Josiah keeps a great Passover. He opposes Pharaoh Neco at Megiddo and is killed, and all Judah mourns him.
35.sw: Yosia anaadhimisha Pasaka kuu. Anampinga Farao Neko huko Megido na kuuawa, na Yuda wote wanamwombolezea.
35.am: ኢዮስያስ ታላቅ ፋሲካ ያከብራል። በመጊዶ ፈርዖን ኒካዑን ይቃወማል፤ ይገደላልም፤ ይሁዳም ሁሉ ያለቅስለታል።

36.en: Judah's last kings are taken away to Egypt and Babylon. Jerusalem and the temple are burned because the people mocked God's messengers, and Cyrus of Persia decrees that the house of God be rebuilt.
36.sw: Wafalme wa mwisho wa Yuda wanachukuliwa hadi Misri na Babeli. Yerusalemu na hekalu vinachomwa moto kwa sababu watu waliwadhihaki wajumbe wa Mungu, na Koreshi wa Uajemi anatoa amri kwamba nyumba ya Mungu ijengwe upya.
36.am: የይሁዳ የመጨረሻ ነገሥታት ወደ ግብፅና ወደ ባቢሎን ይወሰዳሉ። ሕዝቡ በእግዚአብሔር መልእክተኞች ስላፌዙ ኢየሩሳሌምና ቤተ መቅደሱ በእሳት ይቃጠላሉ፤ የፋርሱ ንጉሥ ቂሮስም የእግዚአብሔር ቤት እንደ ገና እንዲሠራ ዐዋጅ ያወጣል።
